name: You've been ReMaid!
detailed_description:
Welcome to Hotel Goetia. A mansion shrouded in mystery that even the locals won't come near! In this light-hearted game of cat and mouse, prepare to be chased around every corner by the most unlikely of main antagonists – adorable yet relentless maids! Only they don't just clean the house, they're also more than willing to open a can of whoopass on you if you intend to cause trouble in their workplace!

Begin the adventure as a traveller stopping at the village at the bottom of the mountain, stock up on supplies and make your way to the mansion before the guards decide to detain you.  Then uncover the mansion's dark past, reveal hidden secrets, and get to the bottom of what really happened there. Dive into a captivating story filled with twists and turns that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Will you get to the bottom of this mystery or become another undead resident?

FEATURES:

  • - Charming stylized anime graphics

  • - A mix of semi immersive sim and stealth with a pinch of horror.

  • - Multiple endings and playable characters each with their own distinctive playstyles.

  • - Enemies that exhibit advanced decision-making skills and react to your actions.

  • - Explore a charming village filled loveable NPCs but also the town guard who have you under their watchful eye. Then the mysterious mansion itself, brimming with atmospheric details and many secrets to uncover that will allow you to piece together past events.

  • - Play in first person or third person

  • - Cooking and potion making

  • - Possibility of romancing certain NPCs including the maids who hunt you down.

  • - Horde based multiplayer mode

MULTIPLAYER MODE:

Horde based 4 player multiplayer mode with different playable characters from the story with their own unique kit and playstyle. 

With more multiplayer modes to come as development on the game continues.

short_description: You've been ReMaid! is a hybrid mix of stealth, immersive sim, dating sim and action in a fantasy setting where the primary antagonists are cute but dangerous maids who have no qualms about teaching you some manners. Will you survive the night?

Minimum:

  • Processor: intel core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 265 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
